title: Provenance/audit data model + portable project store (append-only, model/version/actor)
context: Every assertion in Systematic-Review-Assist — every screening disposition, extracted value, and risk-of-bias evidence — must carry a provenance record: source id, citation (DOI/PMID), retrieval date, verbatim span + character/section location, licence/legal-status note, model id + version + prompt hash (for AI-proposed items), human actor + decision, and timestamp. The store must be append-only so the audit trail is tamper-evident. The project must also be self-contained and portable (SQLite via a thin data layer; JSON/CSV exports) so a review is a version-controllable artefact that can run in low-resource settings. Depends on the monorepo skeleton (002).
objective: Implement the provenance/audit data model and portable project store in @hee-lee-oss/sra-core: define the Provenance record type (source, citation, retrieval date, verbatim span + location, licence note, model id+version+prompt hash, human actor, action, timestamp); implement an append-only SQLite-backed store via a thin data layer; expose typed read/write APIs; and add tests that assert no assertion may exist without a provenance record.
acceptanceCriteria: A typed Provenance record is defined with all required fields: source id, citation (DOI/PMID), retrieval date, verbatim span + location, licence/legal-status note, model id + version + prompt hash (for AI items), human actor, action, and timestamp
The project store is append-only: writes add new records; no update/delete API exists; tests assert the append-only invariant
The store persists to a portable SQLite file via a thin data layer; a review project is a single self-contained file that can be moved between machines
JSON and CSV export paths exist so data can be handed off to external tools without requiring SQLite access
All screening dispositions, extracted values, and audit events created via the store API carry a Provenance record; the API rejects writes without one
pnpm build && pnpm test pass with provenance model and store tests green
output: A merged PR adding the Provenance type, append-only portable SQLite project store, and typed read/write APIs to @hee-lee-oss/sra-core, with tests asserting the append-only invariant and provenance coverage on all assertions.
